name: OK
description: Standard response for successful HTTP requests.

name: Created
description: Request fulfilled and resulted in a new resource created.

name: No Content
description: Request successfully processed but returns no message body.

name: Moved Permanently
description: Resource has permanently moved to a new URI.

name: Not Modified
description: Client cache is still fresh based on ETag or If-Modified-Since.

name: Bad Request
description: Server cannot process request due to malformed syntax.

name: Unauthorized
description: Authentication is required and has failed or not been provided.

name: Forbidden
description: Server understood request but refuses to authorize it.

name: Not Found
description: Origin server did not find a current representation for target.

name: Conflict
description: Request conflicts with current state of the target resource.

name: Unprocessable Entity
description: Semantic errors in request body despite correct syntax.

name: Too Many Requests
description: Client has sent too many requests in a given amount of time.

name: Internal Server Error
description: Generic error message when server encounters unexpected condition.

name: Bad Gateway
description: Server received invalid response from upstream server.

name: Service Unavailable
description: Server is currently unable to handle request due to overload or maintenance.

name: Gateway Timeout
description: Server acting as gateway did not receive timely upstream response.
